basic_profile.bio: I'm a college student based in the Midwest, majoring in history with a minor in computer science. I grew up playing online games like Poptropica, which sparked my interest in gaming communities. In my free time, I love tinkering with software and listening to history podcasts. I typically browse Reddit during the evenings after classes, often while sipping on a strong cup of coffee. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring new hiking trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm fairly new to in-depth gaming discussions but have a strong foundation in historical research and analysis from my coursework. My interest in technology and games has grown through self-teaching and online tutorials. I've recently started exploring historical-themed video games, blending my academic interests with my hobby.
